questions.stem: Creating personas—brief profiles of imaginary characters that represent key segments of a customer base—can help user experience (UX) designers think like and empathize with those using their products. Fictional yet realistic, ________ Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.A: these personas include specific details (demographics, browsing habits, etc.) that UX designers draw from actual users.
options.B: UX designers include specific details (demographics, browsing habits, etc.) drawn from actual users in these personas.
options.C: actual users are the source of the specific details (demographics, browsing habits, etc.) that UX designers include in these personas.
options.D: specific details that UX designers draw from actual users (demographics, browsing habits, etc.) are included in these personas.

The following text is from the 1989 novel The Ancient Child by Kiowa writer N. Scott Momaday. The main character has achieved tremendous commercial success as a painter.

More and more often he was asked to compromise his art or himself in one way or another, and more often than not he did so, for he was inclined to be passive and naïve; it was difficult for him to say no. Those who exhibited his work, who praised and purchased it, and who demanded its proliferation began to determine it.

©1989 by N. Scott Momaday

As used in the text, what does the word “determine” most nearly mean?

A pioneer in the field of taphonomy (the study of how organic remains become fossils), ________ may be just as prevalent in the fossil record as those of thick-shelled organisms.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.A: fossils of thin-shelled organisms, Anna Behrensmeyer demonstrated in a 2005 analysis,
options.B: Anna Behrensmeyer demonstrated in a 2005 analysis that fossils of thin-shelled organisms
options.C: it was demonstrated in a 2005 analysis by Anna Behrensmeyer that fossils of thin-shelled organisms
options.D: a 2005 analysis—by Anna Behrensmeyer—demonstrated that fossils of thin-shelled organisms

The following text is adapted from Kenneth Grahame's 1908 novel The Wind in the Willows.

The Mole has been found by a friend after getting lost in the woods. It is beginning to snow.

The Mole saw the wood that had been so dreadful to him in quite a changed aspect. Holes, hollows, pools, pitfalls, and other menaces to the wayfarer were vanishing fast, and a gleaming carpet was springing up everywhere, that looked too delicate to be trodden upon by rough feet.

As used in the text, what does the word “delicate” most nearly mean?

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes: • Lighthouses send out crucial light signals to help ships and other watercraft navigate at night. • Before automation, lighthouses were run by lighthouse keepers. • Laura J. Hecox was the lighthouse keeper at Santa Cruz Light in California. • She held this position for thirty-four years (1883–1917). • Catherine A. Moore was the lighthouse keeper at Black Rock Harbor Light in Connecticut. • She held this position for sixty-one years (1817–1878).

The student wants to compare the length of time Laura J. Hecox and Catherine A. Moore worked as lighthouse keepers. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.A: From 1883 to 1917, the nighttime waters of California were more navigable thanks to lighthouse keepers Laura J. Hecox and Catherine A. Moore.
options.B: Laura J. Hecox and Catherine A. Moore were both lighthouse keepers at a time when such a person was needed to operate a lighthouse.
options.C: Laura J. Hecox worked as a lighthouse keeper for thirty-four years, but Catherine A. Moore did so for even longer: sixty-one years.
options.D: Before automation, lighthouse keepers like Laura J. Hecox, who served for thirty-four years, and Catherine A. Moore were crucial to ensuring safe navigation for watercraft.

Depth ranges of four stony coral species$$\begin{array}{|l|c|c|c|}\hline \text{Species} & \text{Location} & \text{Minimum depth (meters)} & \text{Maximum depth (meters)} \\ \hline \text{Acropora awi} & \text{Indo-Pacific} & 0 & 5 \\ \hline \text{Indophyllia macassarensis} & \text{Indo-Pacific} & 20 & 25 \\ \hline \text{Isophyllia rigida} & \text{Caribbean} & 3 & 20 \\ \hline \text{Scolymia cubensis} & \text{Caribbean} & 10 & 92 \\ \hline\end{array}$$ (The underlined part of the text is shown here in bold.)
A marine biologist is researching four stony coral species in Caribbean and Indo-Pacific waters. The biologist classifies the water column into two zones based on depth below the surface: the shallow zone (less than 30 meters) and the mesophotic zone (30 meters or more). To study a group whose every recorded sighting falls entirely within the shallow zone, the biologist should focus on sightings of species found in __________

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?

options.A: Indo-Pacific waters in the mesophotic zone.
options.B: Caribbean waters in the shallow zone.
options.C: Caribbean waters in the mesophotic zone.
options.D: Indo-Pacific waters in the shallow zone.

The following text is from Ralph Waldo Emerson's 1841 essay "The Method of Nature."

The scholars are the priests of that thought which establishes the foundations of the earth. No matter what is their special work or profession, they stand for the spiritual interest of the world, and it is a common calamity if they neglect their post in a country where the material interest is so predominant as it is in America.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

options.A: In a country whose citizens are largely preoccupied with tangible gains, it is crucial that some people work to foster and preserve ideas.
options.B: Military experience encourages Americans to contemplate aspects of human life that they would not choose to otherwise.
options.C: Many descriptions of the role of scholars in society unfairly diminish their importance.
options.D: It is unfortunate that so many intellectuals are concerned with material things rather than ideas.
